note: AtliQ's usual positions, learned from its signed contracts and negotiation notes. 'count' explains how usual. Used for the comparison table (A2). Supplier side unless stated.

terms.hard_line: Never unlimited — walked away from Kessler Mobility (Jan 2026) over unlimited liability

terms.usual: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of delay attributable to AtliQ, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no penalty for client-caused delay; sole remedy for delay
exceptions: Al Noor: 1%/week on milestone, cap 10% of total fees — deliberate one-off ('not our new standard')

terms.usual: Always required when a delay penalty exists
terms.source: Checklist + Brightwater post-mortem (client caused 19-day delay, AtliQ still paid)

terms.usual: Mutual; each party covers its own breach/negligence; never cover the client's own negligence
terms.source: PayTrack (Jan 2025): 'we can't insure against PayTrack's own negligence'

terms.usual: Client owns deliverables created specifically for it on payment; AtliQ keeps pre-existing tools and grants a licence
exceptions: Northwind §9.2 assigned pre-existing tools — waved through ('I skimmed the IP')

terms.usual: Mutual, ~30 days' notice; client pays for work done and work in progress
India for Pvt Ltd; a US state for Inc
exceptions: Northwind: English law accepted ('not worth losing the deal')

terms.usual: Mutual, with standard exceptions (public, already known, independently developed, received from a third party, required by law); about 3 years after term
Professional indemnity ~USD 1M; AtliQ cyber policy is USD 1M
When AtliQ is the buyer (agency/freelancer): no per-day penalty, 30-day payment, liability capped at fees for both sides
terms.source: PixelCraft (Oct 2025): 'I don't want our paper to be the thing I hate receiving'
